lede: The web spent the day on Patrick Stewart. His Wikipedia page drew 2,356,552 views, more than six times the next most-read article, while Hacker News and Lemmy both carried posts reporting that the actor has died. Hacker News otherwise divided its attention between a claimed 5.6 billion dollar theft from Binance and Mistral's release of the open weights for Mistral Large 4, which topped the board at 1,288 points. Far out in the South Pacific, a magnitude 6.4 quake struck southeast of Easter Island, well away from land and raising no tsunami.

throughlines.title: Patrick Stewart
throughlines.gist: Reports of the actor's death surfaced on Hacker News and Lemmy at the same hour his Wikipedia page became the single most-read article on the site.

throughlines.title: 2026 Israeli legislative election
throughlines.gist: Wikipedia readers and Polymarket traders converged on the same contest, with the prediction market pricing whether Likud takes the most seats.

throughlines.title: Apex Legends: Cipher Gameplay Trailer
throughlines.gist: A new Cipher gameplay trailer trended on YouTube and carried Apex Legends back onto Steam's charts alongside it.
